aka.zh: 二连浩特至广州国家高速公路集宁至阿荣旗联络线

tagline.en: A link of about 1,450 km along the south-eastern side of Inner Mongolia, from Ulanqab across the Xilingol grassland to Hulunbuir, made by upgrading the region's old inter-provincial highway section by section
tagline.zh: 沿内蒙古东南一侧延伸约 1450 公里的联络线，自乌兰察布横贯锡林郭勒草原直抵呼伦贝尔，由自治区原省际大通道逐段升级而成

start.en: Baiyinchagan, Chahar Right Rear Banner, Ulanqab, where the route leaves G55; officially it starts at Jining, but that stretch is shared with G55 and signed only G55
start.zh: 乌兰察布市察哈尔右翼后旗白音察干，路线在此离开 G55；名义起点为集宁，但该段与 G55 共线，只挂 G55 编号

en: G5511 runs north-east along the south-eastern side of Inner Mongolia: from Jining in Ulanqab across the southern Xilingol grassland, through Jingpeng and Daban in Chifeng, Zarud Banner in Tongliao, Ulanhot in Xing'an League and Zalantun to Arun Banner in Hulunbuir. Its planned length is about 1,458 km. It is a link of the Erenhot–Guangzhou expressway, G55, which it leaves at Baiyinchagan.

Much of it was made by upgrading the region's old inter-provincial highway, an existing class I road, to expressway; the China Transport News called the last piece the closing section of that upgrade. The page's line has a gap in Zarud Banner, where the Chabaiyintala–Caogaotu section had not opened by October 2026.
zh: G5511 沿内蒙古东南一侧向东北延伸：自乌兰察布集宁，横贯锡林郭勒草原南部，经赤峰的经棚、大板，通辽的扎鲁特旗，兴安盟乌兰浩特以及扎兰屯，至呼伦贝尔阿荣旗，规划全长约 1458 公里。它是二广高速 G55 的联络线，在白音察干离开 G55。
相当部分路段由自治区原省际大通道（既有一级公路）升级为高速公路；《中国交通报》称最后一段为这项升级的“收官段”。页面线形在扎鲁特旗有缺口，那里的查白音他拉至草高吐段截至 2026 年 10 月尚未通车。

en: The upgrades mostly follow the old road. Anye–Gongzhugeng, 178.851 km across the Xilingol grassland, rebuilt the existing class I road along its whole main line as a four-lane expressway for 120 km/h. Chabaiyintala–Caogaotu, 108.652 km, rebuilds 78.7 km of old road and adds 30 km of new line, for 100 km/h, with 114 km of parallel service road for local traffic. Caogaotu–Ulanhot, 158.273 km, likewise has 152 km of service road.
zh: 升级工程大多沿老路进行。横跨锡林郭勒草原的安业至公主埂段长 178.851 公里，主线全部利用既有一级公路改建为双向四车道高速公路，设计时速 120 公里。查白音他拉至草高吐段长 108.652 公里，其中改建 78.7 公里、新建 30 公里，设计时速 100 公里，同步建设辅道 114 公里供地方交通使用。草高吐至乌兰浩特段长 158.273 公里，同样建有辅道 152 公里。

en: The northern end came first. Ulanhot–Zalantun opened on 10 April 2017 as Xing'an League's first expressway, and Zalantun–Arun Banner followed on 20 January 2021. The rest was built as a programme: in 2022 the region's development and reform commission said nine projects, about 1,324 km of main line and about 45.5 billion yuan in all, had been approved.

The pieces then opened in quick succession. Gongzhugeng–Jingpeng opened on 10 April 2023, Caogaotu–Ulanhot on 20 April 2023, Baiyinchagan–Anye on 5 May 2023, and Daban–Chabaiyintala at the end of 2023. Anye–Gongzhugeng opened on 28 October 2024, cutting the drive from Xilingol to Hohhot from seven hours to five. The last to start, Chabaiyintala–Caogaotu, was begun on 25 July 2023; its main line was joined up on 20 October 2025 and it passed handover acceptance on 30 September 2026, with opening expected within the year. Between Jingpeng and Daban the route shares about 111 km with G16.
zh: 北端最先建成。乌兰浩特至扎兰屯段于 2017 年 4 月 10 日通车，是兴安盟第一条高速公路；扎兰屯至阿荣旗段于 2021 年 1 月 20 日通车。其余部分作为一个整体推进：2022 年，自治区发展改革委表示，已批复 9 个项目，主线约 1324 公里，总投资约 455 亿元。

此后各段相继建成。公主埂至经棚段 2023 年 4 月 10 日通车，草高吐至乌兰浩特段 4 月 20 日通车，白音察干至安业段 5 月 5 日通车，大板至查白音他拉段 2023 年底通车。安业至公主埂段 2024 年 10 月 28 日通车，锡林郭勒盟至呼和浩特的车程由 7 小时缩短至 5 小时。最后开工的查白音他拉至草高吐段于 2023 年 7 月 25 日开工，主线 2025 年 10 月 20 日贯通，2026 年 9 月 30 日通过交工验收，预计年内通车。经棚至大板之间约 111 公里与 G16 共线。

en: The route has no single published cost. The 2022 approval put the programme at about 45.5 billion yuan for nine projects, and each section was costed separately; the sections built before it, Ulanhot–Zalantun and Zalantun–Arun Banner, are not in that total. Several sections, among them Anye–Gongzhugeng, Caogaotu–Ulanhot and Chabaiyintala–Caogaotu, were built and are run by Inner Mongolia Transport Group, the region's state-owned transport company.
zh: 全线没有单一的公开造价。2022 年批复的 9 个项目总投资约 455 亿元，各段分别核算；此前建成的乌兰浩特至扎兰屯、扎兰屯至阿荣旗两段不在该总数之内。安业至公主埂、草高吐至乌兰浩特、查白音他拉至草高吐等多段由自治区国有企业内蒙古交通集团建设和运营。

value.en: About 45.5 billion yuan for the nine projects approved by 2022 (about 1,324 km of main line); costed by section, and excluding sections built earlier
value.zh: 截至 2022 年批复的 9 个项目（主线约 1324 公里）总投资约 455 亿元；按路段分别核算，不含此前建成路段

The Paper, Chahar Right Rear Banner government account, May 2023

value.zh: 批复工程概算 62.8 亿元

figures.source: Xilingol League Administrative Office, 31 October 2024; China News Service Inner Mongolia, 1 October 2024

Taipingyang Chenbao, 23 April 2023; Inner Mongolia project list, September 2020 (6.86 billion)

why.en: No breakdown of funding has been published for the route or its sections. The builders were Inner Mongolia's state-owned transport investment companies, Inner Mongolia Highway Transport Investment and Development Co. and Inner Mongolia Transport Group.
why.zh: 全线及各段均未公布出资构成。建设单位为自治区国有交通投资企业内蒙古公路交通投资发展有限公司和内蒙古交通集团。

figures.source: Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region People's Government, as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 集宁—阿荣旗高速公路

timeline.en: Ulanhot–Zalantun, Xing'an League's first expressway, opens on 10 April.
timeline.zh: 4 月 10 日，兴安盟第一条高速公路乌兰浩特至扎兰屯段通车。

timeline.en: Work on Baiyinchagan–Anye begins on 10 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 10 日，白音察干至安业段开工。

timeline.en: Caogaotu–Ulanhot is begun on 7 June and Daban–Chabaiyintala in August.
timeline.zh: 6 月 7 日，草高吐至乌兰浩特段开工；8 月，大板至查白音他拉段开工。

timeline.en: Zalantun–Arun Banner opens on 20 January; work on Anye–Gongzhugeng begins in September.
timeline.zh: 1 月 20 日，扎兰屯至阿荣旗段通车；9 月，安业至公主埂段开工。

timeline.en: The region reports nine projects, about 1,324 km and 45.5 billion yuan, approved.
timeline.zh: 自治区通报 9 个项目获批，主线约 1324 公里，总投资约 455 亿元。

timeline.en: Gongzhugeng–Jingpeng, Caogaotu–Ulanhot, Baiyinchagan–Anye and Daban–Chabaiyintala open; Chabaiyintala–Caogaotu is begun on 25 July.
timeline.zh: 公主埂至经棚、草高吐至乌兰浩特、白音察干至安业、大板至查白音他拉各段相继通车；7 月 25 日，查白音他拉至草高吐段开工。
10 月 28 日，安业至公主埂段通车。

timeline.en: The main line of Chabaiyintala–Caogaotu is joined up on 20 October.
timeline.zh: 10 月 20 日，查白音他拉至草高吐段主线贯通。

timeline.en: Chabaiyintala–Caogaotu, the last section, passes handover acceptance on 30 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 30 日，最后一段查白音他拉至草高吐段通过交工验收。
